title: Contributions, counted
label: A contributor table for a community app. Contributions land one after another, points count up, and the rows re-sort themselves by total.
heading:
Contributions,
counted
body: Propose changes, test ideas, join discussions and help make decisions. Your contributions earn points and build a record of what you’ve helped improve.
note: Every contributor is verified as one real human. Bots don’t get a seat at the table.
